capabilities: Substitute quotes, dashes, ellipses and arrows while typing
Skip code, math, wikilinks, frontmatter, HTML tags and URLs
Restore typed characters with Backspace after a substitution
Apply typography to a selection or whole note
Set per-note, per-folder or per-language quotation conventions
disambiguation: Not a reading-view-only renderer; it rewrites the characters in the note as you type or via a command.
extras: Free; the author lists optional one-time-payment extras (Pro add-ons and ready-made vaults) for other plugins, not this one. Needs Obsidian 1.3.5+. 234 tests cover the substitution engine; the editor side was checked manually on Obsidian 1.13.7 Linux, while physical dead-key layouts on GNOME and real Android/iOS keyboards remain untested. iOS Smart Punctuation must be turned off for the chosen quote convention and en dash to apply. Deliberately excludes reading-view-only substitution, superscripts/subscripts, unit symbols and right-to-left quote order. Exposes an extension API (app.plugins.getPlugin('typography-as-you-type').api) so other plugins can set a note's quote and dash characters.
intentEvidence: This is a rebuild rather than a fork. The plugin it replaces, mgmeyers/obsidian-smart-typography
motivation: The plugin it replaces, mgmeyers/obsidian-smart-typography, has had no release since June 2022, and its open issues are the specification for this one.
problem: Obsidian leaves straight quotes, double hyphens and three dots as typed, so notes lack proper typographic marks and converting them by hand risks breaking code and links.

relations.evidence: The plugin it replaces, mgmeyers/obsidian-smart-typography, has about 170,000 downloads
other plugins that also handle typing, Easy Typing among them (#66)

summary: Live typography plugin that converts straight quotes, dashes, ellipses and arrows as you type, skipping code, math, links and frontmatter.
